intro: Viking 2 touched down in Utopia Planitia on September 3, 1976 — the second of the twin Viking landers, on the opposite side of Mars from Viking 1. Its 1,316-sol mission included the first observation of water-ice frost on Mars (during the polar winter), repeating Viking 1's biology experiments at a much colder, higher-latitude site. Killed in April 1980 by a battery failure.
